title: AttackIntegrityAnalyzer and TailIntegrityAnalyzer — onset/tail quality metrics
description:
Implement Source/Analysis/AttackIntegrityAnalyzer and Source/Analysis/TailIntegrityAnalyzer using Performance Timeline / frame data (not new audio FFT paths) per phase-H goal and Appendix A.4 formulas.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md Appendix A.4 Attack and Tail Integrity Analyzers
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.1 (missed attacks, chopped tails visibility)
- Source/Analysis/PerformanceHistory.h ring series and Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h AnalysisFrame / QualityMode from h.1–h.2

Implement AttackIntegrityAnalyzer.h/.cpp:
- Per-onset attack preservation ratio A_r = sum(y²) / sum(x²) over a configurable attack window (samples or ms around transient marker), where x is main/input energy series and y is output (gain-shaped) energy — use PerformanceHistory series or explicit push of windowed energies already available from timeline data.
- Classify each onset: preserved / partial / missed via simple thresholds on A_r (document defaults, e.g. preserved ≥0.9, partial ≥0.5, else missed).
- Summaries: counts over the retained history window; latest A_r; mean A_r. Fixed-capacity onset event log.
- observe(const PerformanceHistory&) or observeOnset(...) APIs callable from message/analysis thread only.

Implement TailIntegrityAnalyzer.h/.cpp:
- Per-tail comparison of main decay vs output decay vs sustain confidence vs closure point (gate entering release/closed).
- Detect lead-note choking: output decays materially faster than main while sustainConfidence remains high before intended musical end — emit a choke score/flag and counts.
- Fixed-capacity tail event log and aggregate stats for GUI Diagnose view.

Both:
- QualityMode Off/Live may disable or thin analysis; Studio/Diagnose enable full summaries.
- prepare/reset; fixed memory; no audio-thread work; no PluginProcessor wiring; no CMake/tests.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: AttackIntegrityAnalyzer computes A_r = sum(y^2)/sum(x^2) over an attack window and classifies preserved/partial/missed
AttackIntegrityAnalyzer exposes aggregate counts or summary statistics over the history window
TailIntegrityAnalyzer compares main decay vs output decay using sustain confidence and closure timing
TailIntegrityAnalyzer can flag/score lead-note choking cases
Both analyzers run with fixed preallocated memory and are intended for background/message thread only
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: run heavy analysis on the audio thread

allowed: consume PerformanceHistory copyRecent buffers rather than owning a second long ring
document A_r classification thresholds as constants adjustable later
use epsilon guards when sum(x^2) is near zero
depend on QualityMode / gate state encoding already defined upstream
forbidden: modify PerformanceHistory storage layout beyond reading its public API
introduce third-party DSP libraries for integrity metrics
